name: ClearText — Readability Score Analyzer
description: Analyze any page for readability. See grade level, reading ease, hard sentences, and plain-language rewrite suggestions.

_permission_justifications.activeTab: Grants temporary access to the current tab only when the user clicks the extension icon, so ClearText can extract page text for readability analysis. No persistent host access is requested.
_permission_justifications.storage: Stores daily usage counts, cached payment status, and per-site readability history in chrome.storage.local. No data is sent to an external server except an anonymous paid-status check.
_permission_justifications.scripting: Used with activeTab to inject a text-extraction function and (for Pro users) sentence-highlighting scripts into the currently active tab. Scripts are only injected on user click and are fully bundled — no remote code is loaded.
